meta.name: The Flores Massacre
meta.description: The story of Matías Bagnato, the sole survivor of the Flores Massacre, one of the most shocking criminal cases in Argentine history.

videos.title: The Massacre
videos.overview: n 1994, an arson fire kills four members of the Bagnato family, leaving 16-year-old Matías as the sole survivor of a horrific attack.

videos.title: The Monster
videos.overview: As Fructuoso faces trial, those close to the Bagnatos continue to live in fear. After sentencing, Matías attempts to rebuild his life.

videos.title: Back to Life
videos.overview: After learning that the man who murdered his family has been released, Matías wages a campaign in pursuit of justice.
